scenes.title: 100-Lux Bedroom Glare Through Sheer Blinds Switched to Pitch-Dark Blackout Drapes
scenes.era: 2023–2024 UK Biobank Wrist Light-Sensor & Northwestern 100-Lux Sleep Trial

layout.description: Adult master bedroom at night where bluish-white streetlamp and hallway light leak across a sleeper's closed eyelids before heavy velvet blackout drapes are pulled shut.

positions.who: 60-year-old adult sleeper (stylized 2.5D vinyl character in soft sage cotton pajamas wearing a small calibrated wrist light-sensor band)
positions.where: rising from the pillow bathed in 100-lux bluish window glare to grasp heavy floor-to-ceiling blackout curtain pulls
positions.facing: three-quarter angle from bed toward tall bedroom window

positions.who: Resting spouse (stylized 2.5D vinyl character in cream sleepwear)
positions.where: clicking off a glowing hallway sconce switch by the bedroom door and setting a paper hardcover book on the nightstand
positions.facing: toward the bedroom door switch and bed

props.name: Heavy floor-to-ceiling slate velvet blackout curtains on brass traverse rod
props.period_detail: thick light-blocking architectural drapery with zero wall text
props.physical_behavior: State A parted sheer blinds spill harsh 100-lux streetlamp glare directly across the pillow -> State B hands sweep heavy velvet blackout panels briskly together until the seam seals into calm <3-lux darkness

props.name: Wrist-worn circular light-sensor band and cloth-bound printed bedside book
props.period_detail: compact UK Biobank-style wrist actigraphy/lux band paired with a classic paper book
props.physical_behavior: wrist sensor catches the sharp drop from bright room glare to calm darkness as the paper book closes on the nightstand

actions.verb_sequence: winces as harsh bedroom glare hits closed eyelids -> sweeps heavy blackout curtains shut and clicks off the hallway sconce into calm darkness

reactions.reaction: settle into deep, slow-breathing stillness with relaxed shoulders

scenes.wardrobe: Soft sage and cream cotton buttoned pajamas.
scenes.lighting: Sharp contrast from 100-lux cool artificial glare to calm <3-lux velvet darkness.
scenes.recognition_hook: Your eyelids aren't blackout curtains—across 86,000 adults, bedroom light at night raised depression risk 30 percent even when they slept!

key_visual.description: a 60-year-old adult wearing a wrist light sensor sweeping heavy blackout curtains shut to block harsh nighttime glare across a bedroom bed

scenes.title: Outdoor Morning Sunlit Garden Walk: Soaking in 10,000-Lux Daylight
scenes.era: Modern 8:15 AM sunlit neighborhood sidewalk & garden

layout.description: Wide sunlit neighborhood sidewalk lined with flowering trees where the same 60-year-old couple walks briskly in radiant morning sky light.

positions.who: 60-year-old adult couple (wearing wrist light sensors and light morning jackets)
positions.where: walking side-by-side outdoors under open morning sky

props.name: Wrist light-sensor band and ceramic morning tea mug on garden wall
props.period_detail: natural morning sky brightness bathing sensor face
props.physical_behavior: sleeper steps out from indoor shade into full golden morning sunlight

actions.verb_sequence: steps outdoors before 9:00 AM without sunglasses -> walks briskly for 15 minutes soaking in bright natural sky light

reactions.reaction: warm, uplifted morning mood and crisp daytime energy

scenes.wardrobe: Light linen and cotton morning walking jackets.
scenes.recognition_hook: Brighter days and darker nights: natural morning sky cut depression risk by 20 percent.

scenes.title: Northwestern Inpatient Sleep Suite: 100-Lux vs <3-Lux Heart-Rate Check
scenes.era: 2022 Northwestern University Feinberg School of Medicine sleep lab

layout.description: Controlled sleep-lab bedroom comparing overhead 100-lux illumination against <3-lux darkness with chest heart-rate sensor leads.

positions.where: physiologist measuring pillow lux level with a handheld light meter beside the sleeping volunteer

props.name: Handheld analog incident-light lux meter at pillow height
props.period_detail: white dome light sensor held beside closed eyelids
props.physical_behavior: needle drops from 100 lux down below 3 lux as overhead dimmer turns off

actions.verb_sequence: checks pillow lux dome under 100-lux ceiling light -> dims room below 3 lux as sleeper's heart rate slows

reactions.reaction: pulse calms out of sympathetic tension into true parasympathetic rest

scenes.wardrobe: Participant in cotton sleep shirt; researcher in white clinical coat.
scenes.recognition_hook: Just one night under 100 lux raises overnight heart rate and next-morning insulin resistance.
